description: Multiplication with full overflow prevention proof. Extends checked_mul from std/core.mm with richer contracts (exact-product ensures plus saturating variants). The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/math/safe_mul — verified multiplication'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm already uses (checked_add, checked_sub, checked_mul, safe_narrow, conditional expressions).

atoms.name: safe_mul
atoms.description: Overflow-proof multiplication of two bounded non-negative i64 values. The product is proven not to exceed max_val by the precondition on each factor's square-root-like bound.

atoms.name: saturating_mul
atoms.description: Saturating multiplication: returns max_val instead of overflowing. Behaves identically to checked_mul but exposes the exact-product ensures when inputs are small.
